evals.prompt: Install the strategy-outcome-design skill into this project for GitHub Copilot.
evals.expected_output: A command plan that detects project scope, targets github-copilot, uses the Nexus Skills runner appropriate to context, installs only strategy-outcome-design, and verifies the installed copy.
assertions: The response does not suggest a global install.
The command targets github-copilot with -a or --agent.
The response includes a verification step.

evals.prompt: Update my installed skills, but only the agents-nexus-skills-manager skill.
evals.expected_output: A narrow upgrade plan that uses --upgrade with --skill agents-nexus-skills-manager, explains replacement behavior, and does not upgrade all installed skills.
assertions: The response uses a skill-specific upgrade.
The response does not run or recommend a broad all-skill upgrade.
The response explains that installed copies may be replaced.

evals.prompt: Install the marketing pack globally for Claude Code and Codex.
evals.expected_output: A global pack install plan that uses --pack marketing, --global, and repeated agent flags for claude-code and codex, with confirmation of the global scope.
assertions: The response includes --global because the user requested it.
The response targets both claude-code and codex.
The response explains the affected global target directories or scope.

evals.prompt: The upgrade prompt says five unrelated skills will be deleted and replaced, but I only wanted to refresh skill-evaluator. What should I do?
evals.expected_output: A troubleshooting response that tells the user to decline the broad upgrade and rerun a skill-specific upgrade for skill-evaluator.
assertions: The response tells the user not to proceed with the broad prompt.
The response identifies broad upgrade scope as the likely cause.
The response includes a verification step after the corrected command.

evals.prompt: Improve the trigger wording in this SKILL.md so it routes better.
evals.expected_output: A refusal or handoff response that says this is skill authoring or review work, not install management, and points to skill-architect when available.
assertions: The response does not run install or upgrade commands.
The response classifies the request as skill authoring or review.
The response names skill-architect or an equivalent authoring workflow.
